description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling CRUD operations and related functionalities for subscription records in the checkout process.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription data in the checkout process, including creation, updates, retrieval, and logging of subscription records.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record in the database with provided data, calculates next date, and adds associated products.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record with new data, recalculates dates, and manages associated products.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription's status in the database.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining cycles of a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial cycles of a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next scheduled date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes subscription records associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record by its ID, decoding payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on filters, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions matching filters.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to a subscription, including options.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes all products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a subscription product by order and product IDs.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a subscription product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options for a subscription.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option for a subscription product.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options for a subscription product.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change history record for a subscription.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Logs an event related to a subscription.
